## Activity

During January 2026, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 84 captures. This represents the activity completed at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. Records should continue to be completed consistently so that activity and outcomes can be monitored together.

## Image quality

Of the 84 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.6 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered when reviewing the overall quality of image capture at the site. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be followed up and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 12 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This indicates the typical interval between the image being taken and the grading outcome being recorded. The clinic lead should continue to review the reported activity, image quality and grading results as part of routine site operations. Any recurring camera issues should be documented through the service desk to support timely investigation and resolution.
